quarterly_data.quarter: SK Hynix press release: "Memory-Centric Server Systems Are the Future": SK hynix (10-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: At OCP Global Summit 2026 (San Jose, held from the 12th to the 15th) SK hynix unveiled its second-generation CMM (CXL Memory Module)-DDR5 product (256GB), optimized for AI workloads and based on CXL 3.2; compared with the previous generation it more than doubles bandwidth (80GB/s) and improves energy efficiency by about 30%, with CXL Pooled functionality also applied. Unveiled at a trade show; the release gives no availability date.
quarterly_data.figure: 256GB; 80GB/s bandwidth (more than double the previous generation); energy efficiency improved by about 30%

quarterly_data.quarter: SK Hynix press release: "Memory-Centric Server Systems Are the Future": SK hynix (10-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Partner NAVER Cloud: SK hynix signed a business agreement with NAVER Cloud in September last year and the two have since worked jointly to resolve bottlenecks in cloud AI services using CXL-based memory solutions. At OCP Global Summit 2026 SK hynix presented PoC-level validation results for a KV cache-sharing solution in an agentic AI environment and an embedding-sharing solution in 'OmniServe', an omni-modal service. Company: having analyzed real customer systems and workloads to confirm the applicability of its CXL-based solutions, SK hynix has laid the groundwork for a full-scale expansion of these solutions.
